answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to capital allocation. An attacker attempting to create an oasis of fake nodes faces the immense shale of financial entry barriers, as acquiring the native token requires significant liquidity. Much like the scarcity of jade, the finite supply of staked assets ensures that the cost of an attack scales linearly with network control, forcing malicious agents to incur prohibitive economic losses to manipulate consensus.
